Players Committee card image of [[Wild Karrde (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “May add 3 pilots and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During battle, your total battle destiny is +1 for each smuggler aboard. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. Immune to attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/wildkarrde_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 793bf65] (15 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
